name: Kraken AI — 50 synthetic procurement cases
description: 50 synthetic two-supplier procurement sets, 10 domains × 5 failure/missing/conflict variants; manually specified requirements, statuses and relevant source lines. Not real supplier documents, not an independent field evaluation. Numerical interval cases use allowed-set/subset semantics.
